news.title: Anthropic confidentially files IPO prospectus with SEC, prepping Wall Street for landmark AI deal
news.detail: Anthropic said it confidentially filed its IPO prospectus with the SEC, setting up a potentially historic share sale for investors ready to jump into AI.

news.title: Anthropico 推进 IPO 进程，加速与 OpenAI 的竞争
news.detail: 人工智能巨头 Anthropic 周一表示，公司已秘密向美国监管机构提交了首次公开募股（IPO）申请，在这场备受关注的上市竞赛中，略微领先于竞争对手 OpenAI。

news.title: S&P 500 closes at a record to kick off June trading as tech rally overpowers oil spike: Live updates
news.detail: The S&P 500 rose on Monday, even as oil prices advanced, with Nvidia leading technology higher following the launch of a new chip for PCs.

news.title: 观点综述：AI热将浇灭沃什快速降息的希望 亚洲科技股超级周期未见顶
news.detail: Apollo首席经济学家称AI热潮将浇灭美联储新任主席沃什快速降息的希望。纽约联储研究显示，比起人工智能，远程办公对年轻毕业生求职影响更大。

news.title: Alphabet plans to raise $80 billion from stock sales to fund AI buildout
news.detail: Alphabet said it plans to sell $80 billion in stock, including through a $10 billion investment by Berkshire Hathaway.

news.title: Microsoft and Google are late to AI coding, but 'absolutely critical' they compete for growth
news.detail: Coding tools are becoming an increasingly big target for Google and Microsoft as they try to catch up to Anthropic and OpenAI.

news.title: Stock futures slip after all three major indexes close at new records: Live updates
